 Wat wij doen:
European Bulk Services B.V. is the major multi purpose bulk terminal operator in the port of Rotterdam. E.B.S. engages in the transhipment, loading, discharge and storage of all kinds of dry bulk products such as coal, minerals, agri- and biomass products to and from Europe.
E.B.S. strives for a tailor-made approach together with its customers (mining companies, energy producers, processing industries, ship owners, traders and commodity brokers, etc.).This entails offering specialized storage and efficient handling of the various commodities 24 hours per day during the week.

E.B.S. is a 100% subsidiary company of HES Beheer N.V. , which is listed on the Amsterdam Stock Exhange.
 Specialiteiten :
Transhipment., Loading., Discharge., Storage., Dry bulk products., Rail loading., Truck loading., Green energy., Recycling., Agribulk.
